purpose: silver_ourairports_airports is the cleaned, one-row-per-airport reference table built from bronze.ourairports_airports (9057 rows), carrying identifiers, facility type, location coordinates, administrative codes and reference links for downstream geography joins and airport dimension builds.
usage: Join on id (integer surrogate from the source feed) or on the equally unique ident and iata_code natural codes. scheduled_service is a true/false boolean rather than 'yes'/'no' text, elevation_ft and id are integers, and latitude_deg/longitude_deg keep full DECIMAL(38,9) precision. Treat icao_code, gps_code, local_code, municipality, home_link, wikipedia_link and keywords as optional and filter on NOT NULL deliberately when a consumer requires them.
limitations: Several columns are sparsely populated and were retained as-is: local_code is null for 5766 rows (63.7%), keywords for 6155 rows (68.0%), home_link for 6784 rows (74.9%), wikipedia_link for 1185 rows (13.1%), icao_code for 1237 rows (13.7%), gps_code for 488 rows (5.4%), municipality for 360 rows (4.0%) and elevation_ft for 335 rows (3.7%). keywords remains an unparsed comma-delimited string, link columns are not validated or normalized, and the id and elevation_ft integer casts are justified only by the ten sampled values each, so a non-integral value outside the sample would fail the build. No deduplication is applied because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0.
